description: Source code for ApkCheck class that verifies APK dependencies against a published API specification, involving XML parsing, hierarchy flattening, and reporting mismatches.

classes.name: ApkCheck
classes.description: Main class for checking APK dependencies against API specifications, including parsing, hierarchy flattening, and reporting.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point, processes command-line arguments, loads API descriptions, and performs checks.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the tool.

methods.name: parseApiDescr
methods.description: Reads and parses an API description XML file into an ApiList.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an XML input source into an ApiList using SAX parser.

methods.name: flattenInherited
methods.description: Expands class hierarchies in ApiList to include inherited methods and fields.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Compares an APK's API list against the public API list to identify mismatches.

methods.name: checkClass
methods.description: Checks individual class, fields, and methods for API compliance.

methods.name: isIgnorable
methods.description: Determines if a package is in the ignore list.

methods.name: apkWarning
methods.description: Outputs a warning message related to APK issues.

methods.name: apkError
methods.description: Outputs an error message related to APK issues.
